articles.title: Hilarious quips and ‘100,000-volt’ energy: the hypemen (and women) redefining Afrobeats music
articles.highlight: 这种以高能即兴人声为核心的喊麦风格，正因其独特的控场魅力而蓬勃发展。
articles.summary: 文章讲述拉各斯大学一名学生因课堂展示获绰号 Toby Shang，他把高中时期担任活动暖场者和家教的经历，转化为感染全场的即兴喊麦风格，后来凭热词与能量走红并推出热门歌曲。如今他自称 Afrohype 或 lamba 子流派的“布道者与先驱”之一，折射出高能互动表演正在重新定义 Afrobeats 的现场表达。对理解 Afrobeats 的现场文化与新子流派有参考价值。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键点在于，现场表演者的即兴互动和控场能力本身就能催生新的音乐子流派与个人品牌。观察这类文化节点，有助于理解音乐产业的传播动力。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Style of emceeing based on high-octane, ad-libbed vocals has flourished thanks to its unique way of captivating crowds For the 2015 freshmen cohort of the history degree programme at the University of Lagos, their classmate’s first-semester presentation was so captivating that they began calling him Toby Shang, after the 16th-century Chinese dynasty he had focused on. His crowd engagement that day had been harnessed from his high school days as a ginger-man (energiser) in a three-man band and as a private tutor. By his final year at university, his viral catchphrases and infectious energy had resulted in a hit song, Shedibalabala.

en.highlight: Style of emceeing based on high-octane, ad-libbed vocals has flourished thanks to its unique way of captivating crowds.
en.summary: The article profiles a University of Lagos student nicknamed Toby Shang after a classroom presentation, whose high-school experience as an energiser and tutor shaped an infectious, improvised emceeing style that later led to viral catchphrases and a hit song. He now calls himself one of the “evangelists and pioneers” of the Afrobeats sub-genre some call Afrohype or lamba, showing how high-energy crowd engagement is redefining live Afrobeats expression. It is useful for understanding Afrobeats live culture and emerging sub-genres.

articles.title: Celebrating 20 Years of The Marginalian and the Search for Meaning: Free Livestream This Friday
articles.highlight: 2006年10月23日，我开始把书籍段落、神经科学研究链接和16世纪日本木刻复制品等发现，通过办公室邮件分享给七位同事。
articles.summary: 文章回顾作者在二十多岁孤独、贫困并打四份工读大学时，持续记录自己对意义的寻找。她把这些发现发给七位同事后，经朋友层层分享而扩散，几年内被美国国会图书馆收录。二十周年之际，本周五将举行免费直播，适合关注长期写作、公共分享与意义探索的读者了解。
articles.failureAnalysis: 一个从七人邮件开始的长期写作项目说明，可持续的内容影响力往往来自真实问题、持续记录和便于转发的分享机制。
articles.sourceExcerpt: At the dawn of my twenties, lonely, destitute, and disoriented by the demands of making a new life in an alien world, I started keeping notes on my search for meaning while working four jobs to pay my way through college. On October 23, 2006, I began sharing my discoveries — passages from books, links to neuroscience studies, reproductions of 16th-century Japanese woodcuts — in an office email to seven colleagues. They in turn began sharing it with friends, who began sharing it with friends.

articles.sourceExcerpt: Extreme anharmonicity determines the superionic transition in the prototypical antifluorite Li2O Lorenzo Bastonero, ∗,†,∥ Chiara Cignarella,†,∥ Nicola Marzari,†,‡,¶ and Lorenzo Monacelli§ †U Bremen Excellence Chair, Bremen Center for Computational Materials Science, and MAPEX Center for Materials and Processes, Universität Bremen, 28359 Bremen, Germany ‡Theory and Simulation of Materials (THEOS), and National Centre for Computational Design and Discovery of Novel Materials (MARVEL), École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne, 1015 Lausanne, Switzerland ¶Laboratory for Materials Simulations, Paul Scherrer Institut (PSI), 5232 Villigen, Switzerland §Departement of Physics, Sapienza Università di Roma, Rome, Italy ∥These authors contributed equally to this work E-mail: lbastone@uni-bremen.de Abstract Superionic conductors are promising electrolyte candidates for all-solid-state batter- ies, thanks to their liquid-like ionic mobility. In the prototypical lithium-ion oxide superionic conductor with antifluorite structure, the high-temperature transition to the fast-ion regime has long been attributed to volume-driven harmonic phonon soft- ening. However, this quasi-harmonic picture neglects the strong lattice anharmonic- ity inherent to the fast-ion regime, leaving the microscopic origin of the transition 1 arXiv:2610.15986v1 [cond-mat.mtrl-sci] 11 Oct 2026 unresolved.

articles.summary: web-edit 是 Simon Willison 自建的一个小型 Web 应用，用来浏览和编辑某个文件夹里的文件，主要场景是通过 Tailscale 在不同机器之间改文件。0.1a2 版本新增了文本与图片数据的“复制到剪贴板”功能。作者需要的起因是：他用手机给笔记本上的 pelican 跑提示词，想把生成的日志方便地复制进 Gist——这说明 AI 工作流会催生一些具体的小工具需求。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键点在于，许多实用工具只是为了让作者自己的个人工作流更顺手，需求就来自真实的使用摩擦，并不需要宏大设计。当 AI 使用场景从桌面扩展到手机、跨设备时，像“复制到剪贴板”这样的细节往往决定流程是否顺畅。

en.summary: web-edit is Simon Willison's small self-built web app for browsing and editing files in a folder, chiefly used to edit files across machines via Tailscale. Version 0.1a2 adds copy-to-clipboard for both text and image data. The need arose because he was running pelican prompts on a laptop from his phone and wanted an easy way to copy the resulting logs into a Gist.
en.failureAnalysis: The takeaway: many useful tools exist just to smooth the author's own workflow, driven by real friction rather than a grand design. As AI usage moves across devices and onto phones, details like copy-to-clipboard often decide whether a workflow flows smoothly.

articles.title: ZeroDayEvil/ai-security-tool
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 这个GitHub项目提供免费开源、由AI驱动的安全终端与漏洞扫描能力，覆盖CVE与SBOM，并集成SSH、SFTP、RDP、VNC、串口等连接方式。仓库描述还称其支持12+自主AI代理（如DeepSeek、OpenAI）来编排自动化安全工作流、CTF与DevSecOps，并配有跨平台Web UI，目前有899颗星。对非技术管理者而言，它可作为观察AI安全工具如何把扫描、终端访问和智能体编排打包在一起的样本。
articles.failureAnalysis: 风险在于，安全终端与漏洞扫描直接接触凭证、内网资产和远程协议，AI代理若误判或越权，可能造成比漏报更严重的操作事故。CVE/SBOM扫描依赖持续更新的情报与规则，12+代理和多种协议会抬高集成、测试与维护成本，免费开源也需明确责任边界。899星只能说明一定关注度，不能证明企业愿意付费或已通过真实环境验证；合规与数据驻留要求还会限制其部署。

en.highlight: Free open-source AI-powered security terminal and vulnerability scanner covering CVE and SBOM, with support for SSH, SFTP, RDP and other protocols.
en.summary: This GitHub repository offers a free, open-source AI-driven security terminal and vulnerability scanner with CVE and SBOM coverage, plus SSH, SFTP, RDP, VNC, and serial connectivity. It claims support for 12+ autonomous AI agents such as DeepSeek and OpenAI to automate security workflows, CTF, and DevSecOps, with a cross-platform web UI and 899 stars. It is worth reading as an example of how scanning, terminal access, and agent orchestration are being bundled into AI security tooling.
en.failureAnalysis: The main risk is that AI agents with access to credentials, internal assets, and remote protocols can cause serious operational errors if they hallucinate or overstep, while CVE/SBOM freshness and multi-protocol integration add ongoing engineering cost. Star count alone does not prove enterprise willingness to pay or validation in real environments, and compliance and data-residency requirements may limit deployment.
en.title: Free Open-Source AI Security Terminal and Vulnerability Scanner with Multi-Protocol Agents
